question: 退货政策是什么
variants: 买东西不想要了能退吗
支持七天无理由退货吗
answer: 本平台支持签收后 7 天内无理由退货（商品需保持完好不影响二次销售）。申请方式：「我的订单」→ 选择订单 → 申请售后 → 退货退款。退货运费：质量问题由平台承担，无理由退货由您承担（运费险可抵扣）。特殊商品（生鲜、定制类、贴身衣物）不支持无理由退货。

question: 退款多久到账
variants: 取消订单后钱退到哪里
answer: 退款审核通过后，原路返回您的支付账户：支付宝/微信 1-3 个工作日到账，银行卡 3-7 个工作日到账，信用卡 7-15 个工作日（以银行为准）。您可在「我的订单 → 退款详情」中实时查看退款进度。

question: 怎么查询物流
answer: 查询物流：进入「我的订单」→ 点击对应订单 → 查看「物流信息」，可看到承运公司、运单号和实时轨迹。普通订单付款后 48 小时内发货，大促期间可能延迟至 72 小时。发货后会通过短信和 App 推送通知您。

question: 怎么修改收货地址
variants: 订单下错了能改地址吗
answer: 修改收货地址分两种情况：①订单还未发货——「我的订单」→ 订单详情 → 修改地址（支持修改 2 次）；②订单已发货——无法直接修改，请联系在线人工客服，我们将协调快递公司尝试转寄（不保证成功）。建议下单前仔细核对地址。

question: 怎么取消订单
variants: 如何取消还没发货的订单
取消订单钱多久能退回来
取消订单退款到账时间
answer: 取消订单：「我的订单」→ 选择订单 → 取消订单 → 选择原因提交。未发货订单取消成功后立即退款，退款原路退回：支付宝/微信 1-3 个工作日到账，银行卡 3-7 个工作日；已发货订单无法取消，请收到货后申请退货。参与限时秒杀/预售的订单按活动规则处理。

question: 怎么开发票
answer: 本平台默认提供电子普通发票，支持在订单完成后 90 天内开具：进入「我的订单」→ 订单详情 → 开具发票，填写抬头信息后发送至您的邮箱。企业增值税专用发票请提交资质审核后开具。纸质发票暂不支持邮寄。

question: 优惠券怎么使用
answer: 优惠券使用：下单确认页点击「优惠券」选择可用券，系统自动抵扣。常见不可用原因：未满足满减门槛、商品不在适用范围、已过期、与其他活动价不可叠加。优惠券领取后自动入账，可在「我的 → 优惠券」中查看有效期和使用规则。

question: 支付失败了怎么办
answer: 支付失败处理：①余额不足/限额——更换支付方式或调整额度；②系统提示失败但扣款——部分银行会延迟反馈，请等待 10-30 分钟后刷新订单状态；若 2 小时后仍未恢复，扣款将在 1-7 个工作日内原路退回。未到账可联系人工客服核查。

question: 配送范围和运费
answer: 配送范围覆盖中国大陆地区（含偏远地区，时效加长）。运费规则：单笔订单满 99 元包邮（生鲜/大家电等特殊类目除外），未满额收取 6-12 元基础运费。港澳台及海外地区暂不提供配送服务。

question: 商品是正品吗
answer: 平台所售商品均来自品牌方或授权经销商，全链路溯源可查。如对商品真伪有异议，可在签收后 15 天内申请第三方权威机构鉴定，鉴定为假将执行「假一赔十」并承担鉴定费用。质量问题支持 7 天退货、15 天换货。

question: 忘记密码怎么办
answer: 找回密码：登录页点击「忘记密码」→ 通过绑定手机号/邮箱接收验证码 → 设置新密码。账号因多次输错密码被锁定时，15 分钟后自动解锁。若手机号已停用无法接收验证码，请联系人工客服进行身份验证后重置。

question: 怎么投诉
answer: 投诉渠道：①在线投诉——联系客服直接说明问题，将为您生成投诉工单，专员 24 小时内跟进；②电话投诉——客服热线 400-XXX-XXXX（9:00-21:00）。所有投诉均会记录处理进度并可查询，处理结果将通过短信通知您。

question: 运费险怎么赔
variants: 运费险不够扣运费怎么办
answer: 您下单时投保的运费险在退货时自动理赔：最高赔付 25 元，超出的运费需您自行承担。理赔款在商家确认收货后 1-7 个工作日内转入您的支付账户。

question: 满减券怎么用
answer: 满减券需订单满 300 元可用，最高可抵扣 50 元；优惠券领取后 30 天内有效，过期作废。订单取消或全额退款后优惠券会自动退回（已过期的不补发）。

question: What is your return policy
variants: how do I return an item
can I return an item I don't want
answer: You may request a no-reason return within 7 days of delivery (items must be intact and resaleable; we also support exchanges within 15 days of delivery). To apply: My Orders → select the order → After-sales → Return & Refund. Return shipping: covered by the platform for quality issues; covered by you for no-reason returns (shipping insurance can offset it). Special categories (fresh food, customized items, intimate apparel) do not support no-reason returns.

question: How long do refunds take
variants: when will I get my money back
how do I check my refund status
where does a cancelled order refund go
answer: Once approved, refunds are returned via your original payment method: Alipay/WeChat within 1-3 business days, bank cards within 3-7 business days, credit cards within 7-15 business days (depending on the issuing bank). You can track real-time refund progress under My Orders → Refund Details.

question: How do I track my package
variants: why hasn't my order shipped yet
how long does shipping take during big sales
answer: To track a package: My Orders → open the order → Shipping Info, showing the carrier, tracking number, and real-time route. Standard orders ship within 48 hours of payment; during major sales this may extend to 72 hours. Once shipped, you'll be notified by SMS and app push.

question: How do I change my delivery address
variants: can I change the address after ordering
answer: Address changes depend on the order state: ① Not yet shipped — My Orders → Order Details → Change Address (allowed twice per order); ② Already shipped — the address can no longer be changed directly; contact online customer support and we will coordinate a redirect with the carrier (success not guaranteed). Please double-check your address before ordering.

question: How do I cancel my order
variants: how to cancel an unshipped order
how long does a cancellation refund take
will my cancellation refund go back to WeChat
answer: To cancel: My Orders → select the order → Cancel Order → choose a reason and submit. Unshipped orders are refunded immediately after cancellation, via the original payment method: Alipay/WeChat within 1-3 business days, bank cards within 3-7 business days. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled — please request a return after delivery. Flash-sale/pre-sale orders follow their event rules.

question: How do I get an invoice
variants: where do I request an invoice
I need an invoice for reimbursement
answer: The platform issues electronic general invoices by default, available within 90 days of order completion: My Orders → Order Details → Request Invoice, fill in the title details, and it will be sent to your email. Enterprise special VAT invoices require a qualification review first. Paper invoices are not currently mailed.

question: How do I use coupons
answer: To use a coupon: on the order confirmation page, tap Coupons and pick an eligible one; the discount is applied automatically. Common reasons a coupon can't be used: the spend threshold isn't met, the item isn't in scope, the coupon expired, or it can't be combined with other promotional prices. Claimed coupons are added to your account automatically; see My Account → Coupons for validity and rules.

question: What if my payment failed
variants: I was charged but the order didn't go through
answer: If payment fails: ① Insufficient balance/limit — switch payment methods or adjust the limit; ② Failure shown but money deducted — some banks report with a delay; wait 10-30 minutes and refresh the order status. If it hasn't recovered after 2 hours, the deduction will be returned via the original payment method within 1-7 business days. If it still hasn't arrived, contact human support to investigate.

question: Where do you deliver and what are the shipping fees
variants: do you ship to Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan
answer: We deliver across mainland China (remote areas included, with longer transit times). Shipping rules: orders of 99 CNY or more ship free (special categories like fresh food and large appliances excepted); below that, a base shipping fee of 6-12 CNY applies. Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas destinations are not served at this time.

question: Are your products authentic
variants: how can you prove it's real
answer: All products on the platform come from brand owners or authorized distributors, with full-chain traceability. If you dispute authenticity, you may request a third-party authentication within 15 days of delivery; a confirmed fake is compensated tenfold, with the authentication fee covered by us. Quality issues support returns within 7 days and exchanges within 15 days.

question: What if I forgot my password
variants: how do I reset my password
answer: To recover a password: on the login page, tap Forgot Password → receive a verification code via your bound phone/email → set a new password. Accounts locked after repeated wrong attempts unlock automatically after 15 minutes. If your phone number is no longer in use, contact human support for identity verification and a reset.

question: How do I file a complaint
variants: I want to file a complaint
how to complain about a merchant
answer: Complaint channels: ① Online — tell customer support about the problem and a complaint ticket will be created, with a specialist following up within 24 hours; ② Phone — hotline 400-XXX-XXXX (9:00-21:00). Every complaint's progress is recorded and trackable, and the outcome is sent to you by SMS.

question: How does shipping insurance pay out
variants: how much does shipping insurance cover
is return shipping insurance worth it
what if the insurance doesn't cover the full shipping fee
answer: Shipping insurance purchased at checkout settles automatically on return: it pays up to 25 CNY, and any excess shipping fee is yours to cover. The payout arrives in your payment account within 1-7 business days after the merchant confirms receipt.

question: How do I use threshold coupons
variants: how much can a threshold coupon save
answer: Threshold coupons require a minimum order of 300 CNY and deduct up to 50 CNY; coupons are valid for 30 days after being claimed and expire after that. Coupons are automatically returned if the order is cancelled or fully refunded (expired ones are not reissued).
